title.narrative: UNICEF supported quality education in Gaza through learning in TLSs with trained teachers and in the West Bank through remedial and STEM programs and summer camps. Nationally, UNICEF advanced the Learning Passport development and successfully advocated for updating the inclusive education policy to ensure quality education for all children.
